requirements.title: Asterisk dummy arguments have no other characteristics
requirements.definition: A dummy argument that is an asterisk has no characteristic beyond being an alternate-return indicator.

pending.asterisk-dummy-has-no-other-characterist: After alternate-return rules are registered, define subroutine choose(*) with no declaration for the asterisk dummy; caller initializes branch marker to -15 and expects the selected alternate path to assign 42.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Unregistered dependencies retained for future fixtures: later clause 15 procedure reference, argument association, interface block, generic resolution, pure/simple/elemental, procedure pointer, and finalization rules; clauses 16, 17, and 18 for intrinsic and intrinsic-module procedures; clause 14 for modules and submodules; clause 3 terminology and clause 19 scoping/lifetime details.
